This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Video Conferencing/Physical Mode).
Learned counsel for the State submitted that notice on the informant is sufficient.
None appears on behalf of the informant.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for the State.

This is an appeal under section 14-A(2) of S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act, 1989 in connection with T.R. Case No. 19 of 2021 arising out of Umerkote P.S. Case No.196 of 2021 pending in the Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge -cum- Special Judge, Umerkote for offences punishable under sections 376(2)(n)/294/506 of the Indian Penal Code read with sections 3(1)(r)(s)/3(2)(v) of the S.C. & S.T.
(PoA) Act.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
// 2 // The appellant moved an application for bail before the Court of learned Addl. Sessions,
Umerkote, which was rejected on 29.09.2021.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is in judicial custody since 27.05.2021 and in the meantime, out of twenty one charge sheet witnesses, seventeen witnesses have been examined including the victim as P.W.12 and in view of the available materials on record and Sibo Bisoi vs State Of Odisha & Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88913416/
1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: particularly, the statement of the victim, the bail application of the appellant may be favouraby considered.
Learned counsel for the appellant has filed the deposition copies of the witnesses examined so far in the learned trial Court, which are taken on record.
Learned counsel for the State placed the evidence of the victim.

It appears from the statement of the victim that she is a married lady and she has stated that the accused was coming to her house in the night in absence of her husband and also staying in her house in presence of her two children and the accused was coming to her by informing her over mobile phone and keeping physical relationship with her.
She further stated that on the date of occurrence, her husband came to know about her relationship with the accused from the conversion between her and the accused in the mobile phone of the accused.
Perused the status report submitted by the learned trial Court.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties, the nature of evidence // 3 // adduced by the prosecution, particularly, the victim in the learned trial Court,
progress of trial so far and taking into account the period of detention of the appellant in judicial custody, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.
Let the appellant be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper with further conditions that he shall not indulge in any criminal activities, shall not keep any contact either with the victim or any of the prosecution witnesses and shall appear before the learned trial Court on each date to which the case would be posted for trial.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
The CRLA is accordingly disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy of this order on proper application.
